name: Phoenix Feather (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
Price 2,000 gp; Aura moderate conjuration; CL 9; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This feather is not truly taken or cast off from a phoenix, but instead is instilled with magic to bring life back to a fallen ally. If placed on a creature that has died within the last 5 rounds, the feather bursts into a harmless flame and disintegrates, and the affected creature is brought back to life with 1 hit point. This item cannot be used on creature who were killed by death effects.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 1,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, Spells breath of life
